title: Tree Guessing
statement: A hidden tree on n ≤ 500 vertices must be reconstructed in at most 2n−2 queries, each choosing a vertex x and a permutation p and returning the sum over all i of the largest p on the path from i to x. Setting p_v = n and p_1 = n−1 returns n(n−1) plus v's subtree size; taking vertices by decreasing size, one designed permutation per vertex decodes its parent.
